expectations.text: Recommends proceeding with the bounded release or gives a specific evidence-based blocker, not generic demands for more validation
expectations.evidence: “Pursue the limited internal release”; “justify proceeding within the approved effort cap.”

expectations.text: Uses internal task outcomes, adoption, alternatives and ownership instead of requiring paying external customers
expectations.evidence: “10 staff chose the helper ... completed all eligible tasks”; “licensed suite and two evaluated alternatives fail a specific requirement”; “IT’s acceptance of maintenance, access and rollback ownership.” No external paying customers required.

expectations.text: Distinguishes time/capacity benefit from realized cash savings
expectations.evidence: “The benefit is staff capacity, not demonstrated cash savings: no layoffs or reduced external spending are planned.”

expectations.text: Does not multiply a median difference into a claimed exact total saving
expectations.evidence: “Median handling time fell from 20 to 8 minutes”; “Medians alone cannot establish aggregate hours saved.” No total is calculated.

expectations.text: Names monitoring or rollback criteria proportionate to a limited release rather than treating it as broad validation
expectations.evidence: “same cohort and eligibility scope for four weeks, within the existing cap”; proposed criteria cover median time, checked errors and cap; “pause and use IT’s rollback process if any threshold fails.”

expectations.text: Does not invent costs or require market sizing and stays within 700 body words
expectations.evidence: “ongoing support effort remains unquantified”; scope is the approved limited release. No invented costs or market-sizing demand. Supplied body count: 307, below 700.

suggestions.reason: Monitoring passes, but the proposed median-under-20 rule would allow most observed benefit to disappear and any sampled error rise triggers rollback without a materiality/comparability condition. A stronger criterion would ask for proportionate, preagreed review triggers.

eval_feedback.overall: Judged only the anonymized memo and frozen case facts. No execution trace was supplied, so tool use or absence of browsing cannot be verified. All six assertions graded separately; compound requirements require every component.
